$comment: RESERVED FOR RUNTIME VALIDATION (JSON Schema cannot enforce these): recomputation and target-binding of artifact_digest_sha256 (the digest must resolve to the specific artifact being attested; digest integrity proves only that bytes were not altered, never that attested facts are true and never that evidence is authenticated host telemetry); attester identity and attestation timing relative to the invocation; cross-artifact binding of opaque_slot_id and attempt_number; and the rule that an attestation (made after the fact) is operator_attested class-B evidence and may never be re-labelled operator_recorded, which is reserved for contemporaneous records. A runtime validator must reject artifacts failing any of these even if they satisfy this schema.
title: EXP-019 v1.2 DRAFT operator attestation artifact (non-executable)
description: DRAFT schema for the prospective EXP-019 v1.2 evidence contract. NOT a frozen protocol and NOT executable: v1.2 is not registered in frozen_protocol(). This records the hash-bound operator attestation for one slot. IMPORTANT: the digest that binds this artifact proves the artifact was not altered after creation; it does NOT establish that the attested facts are true. The attested facts remain operator evidence, not authenticated host telemetry.

attested_by.description: Identifier of the attesting operator. Not a treatment-bearing value.

artifact_digest_sha256.description: Digest binding this artifact. Integrity only, not truth.

assertions.description: The operator's attested account of their own conduct.
